import pandas as pd

# Source file paths
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_55/test_0.csv"

# Load source data
# index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column as per Hint 24
df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)

# Transformation:
# Target schema: ['V_GENE']
# Source schema: ['J_CALL']
# Observing the example values:
# Source J_CALL values look like "IGHJ5*02"
# Target V_GENE values look like "IGHJ5"
# So we need to extract the part before the '*' character from J_CALL to get V_GENE

df_target = pd.DataFrame()
df_target['V_GENE'] = df_source0['J_CALL'].str.split('*').str[0]

# Output path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_55/target_multisource_cot.csv"

# Save the transformed data to CSV
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
